courses.title: ToolTest 26 - As-Built Joint
courses.objective: Create a joint between components that are already positioned, keeping their current placement as the joint zero position.

steps.title: Position two components
steps.instructions: Place two components in their intended assembled positions before creating the joint.
steps.expectedResult: Both parts are in the desired starting pose.

checkpoint.expected: Both parts are in the desired starting pose.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Start As-built joint
steps.instructions: Pick the two positioned components and the connection axis/point.
steps.expectedResult: The As-built Joint dialog is ready without repositioning the parts.

checkpoint.expected: The As-built Joint dialog is ready without repositioning the parts.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Create the joint
steps.instructions: Choose the required joint type and commit.
steps.expectedResult: A joint is created with the current placement as its zero position.

checkpoint.expected: A joint is created with the current placement as its zero position.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Inspect the zero position
steps.instructions: Inspect or exercise the joint from its starting configuration.
steps.expectedResult: Zero returns to the original as-built placement.

checkpoint.expected: Zero returns to the original as-built placement.

validationChecks: Original placement is the zero reference
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
